conventions.base_url: http://<host>:8096 (HTTPS commonly uses port 8920; deployments may differ)
conventions.auth_header: X-Emby-Authorization: Emby Client="...", Device="...", DeviceId="...", Version="..." [, UserId="...", Token="..."]
conventions.login: POST /Users/AuthenticateByName with {Username, Pw}; response includes AccessToken, User, SessionInfo, ServerId
conventions.tick: 1 second = 10,000,000 ticks; *Ticks fields use this unit
conventions.paging: QueryResult commonly contains Items and TotalRecordCount; consult each endpoint for StartIndex and Limit
conventions.fields: Use Fields to request supported optional item fields; do not assume list responses contain full item details
conventions.image: GET /Items/{Id}/Images/{Type}?tag={Tag}&maxHeight={h}; use ImageTags[Type] when present, otherwise a placeholder
conventions.case: Preserve the exact case of JSON field names (usually PascalCase)
conventions.missing_type: An empty source type is unknown. Chinese parameter tables may show name-based hints, not verified source types
conventions.required: Trust name_marker, explicit notes, or sourced verification. Unknown/unspecified does not mean optional

provenance.incomplete_policy: Only three known BackupApi HTTP 404 details are allowed

meta.usage: Search services[].endpoints by path/method. Open file and find heading '## <section>. ' for the Chinese reference, or read source_data for untranslated parameter and model definitions. Endpoint titles retain official summaries when available.
